assumed_formats.events.ndjson: capture-spec-v2 section 1 (fixed): a header line {kind: header, ...}, then {i, t_ms, key}. M1 has no events.ndjson: its plan is schedule.ndjson (the same format)
assumed_formats.hook.ndjson: a header line and a footer line (type header / footer), then one line per event {type: key, t_ns, down, injected, ours, repeat, kind}; kind one of COUNTED_KINDS or modifier / nonchar (not counted); auto-repeated downs are left out
assumed_formats.page.ndjson: one line per keydown {type: key, t_ms (event.timeStamp), h_ms, kind, repeat, trusted, composing, in_box}; other lines (open, status, ready, armed, log) have another type
assumed_formats.inject.ndjson: replays: a header line {type: header, ...}, then one line per press {i, planned_ns, sent_ns, returned_ns, late_ns, sendinput_returned, n_inputs, ok}; M1: no header, one line per press {i, token, wished_ms, plan_ms, planned_ns, sent_ns, returned_ns, wait_ns, queue_len, sendinput_returned, n_inputs, ok}. A failed press is ok false
assumed_formats.llm.ndjson (M1): lines of type header, request, chunk {n, recv_ns, token, n_chars, done}, error and final; the chunk with done true ends the generation (its recv_ns is a_{K+1}) and its text, if any, is a last token arriving at a_{K+1}. Characters outside printable ASCII and the \r of \r\n are skipped: their slots stay empty and the running maximum is taken over the typed characters (the researcher's decision E-5 of 2026-11-04); \n is Enter
assumed_formats.runlog.ndjson: a header line, one line per item {type: item, item: '<series>/<unit>', result: done | redone | failed | no_plan, detail, attempts} and a footer line; the folder <series>/<unit> holds the last attempt (a first interrupted attempt is <unit>.try1, not read); a failed item keeps its plan files (events.ndjson; M1 llm.ndjson and, when the stream ended without an error, schedule.ndjson); a failed plan of fewer than 2 presses is no plan
assumed_formats.L1 events: L0's hook-layer counted presses between the signal and the end chord (meta.json typing_start_perf_ns to typing_end_perf_ns), auto-repeats left out, stable-sorted with equal times dropped (v6's rule), times from the first press, keys the kinds' representatives (capture code events.from_live)
assumed_formats.meta.json: typing_start_perf_ns and typing_end_perf_ns (the same clock as the hook's t_ns): L0's hook layer is read between them

cleaning.ties_kept_note: on the human side only the recorded series keep equal times; H0 is KUPA's counted presses, which drop them by definition (data.counted_press), and H1 replays only those
